title: Tracking View for Weekview
description:
Instead of showing the entries for the Weekview either per TrackerEntry, or grouped by booking element, we shall provide a treeview.

The weekview is redesigned, in a way, that it shows for a given day and all TrackerEntries grouped, by BookingElement, in a kind of treeview:
* (+|-) Monday yyyy-mm-dd
  * (+|-) <Booking Element> (hh:mm) [Copy Button]
    * <TrackerEntry> (hh:mm) [Copy Button]

For every weekday, there is a line with an expand (+) or collapse (-) icon. Than the next level shows the Booking Elements, with the sum of the time spent, for each TrackingEntry, for that given day. The next level shows the TrackingEntries with the total time spent on them for that given day.

The copy button of the items, shall only copy the name of the items not its time spent. The previous, current, and next week buttons remain unchaged. 

By default, all entries are collapsed when opening the view. When the week is changed, also all entries are shown collapsed.
design:
## Redesign: week view as a collapsible tree

Replace the seven side-by-side day columns with a single vertical tree:

    [-/+] Mon 21.09.   SUM 1:30        PC 7:15 active / 1:20 idle
        [-/+] Project X (1:30)  [copy]
              Report (1:00)  [copy]
              Review (0:30)  [copy]
        [-/+] <None> (1:00)  [copy]
    [-/+] Tue 22.09.
    [-/+] Wed 23.09.
    ...                                (all seven days, always present)

### Confirmed decisions

1. Day caption keeps the current "Mon 21.09." format.
2. The day row shows the day's sum (e.g. "1:30" with the sigma).
3. Every **booking element** copy button copies the **task names inside that
   element group**, one per line. This supersedes the earlier "<element>"
   copy semantics and applies to all booking-element copy buttons.
4. Entries with no booking element form their own group named "<None>".
5. Entry (leaf) rows are merged by task name, with the summed duration.
6. The "Group by booking element" checkbox is removed; the tree always groups
   Day -> Booking element -> Task.
7. All nodes start collapsed, and collapse again whenever the week changes.
   Expansion is kept across live data refreshes (a session being saved).
8. The gray PC activity line is appended to the day row.

### Architecture (view models)

- WeekViewModel (changed): drops GroupByBookingElement/SetGrouping; a week
  change collapses all nodes; UpdateSessions/UpdateActivitySpans keep the
  user's expansion. Also drops the unused ActivityText/UpdateActivitySpans
  path (dead code: the visible PC line comes from IWeekDayContributor).
- WeekDayViewModel (changed): day node with IsExpanded + ToggleCommand and
  Groups as IReadOnlyList<WeekElementGroupViewModel>; EntriesText removed.
- WeekElementGroupViewModel (new): element node with Name ("<None>" when
  empty), TotalText, IsExpanded, ToggleCommand, CopyText (task names), Entries.
- WeekEntryViewModel (new): leaf node with Task, TotalText, CopyText.
- WeekDayGroup (removed): superseded by the node view models.

Ordering: elements then tasks by earliest start, tie-broken by name. Grouping
and matching are case-insensitive (first-seen spelling kept), consistent with
the history list.

Expansion lifecycle:

    Move(+/-7) / MoveToCurrentWeek() -> Rebuild() -> collapse all
    UpdateSessions(...)              -> Rebuild() -> keep day IsExpanded,
                                                     match element IsExpanded by name

### Architecture (view)

WeekDaysGrid is replaced by Views/Components/WeekTrackingTree.cs, built the
same imperative way (no XAML), taking the IWeekDayContributor list (day-row
activity) and an IWeekStatusHost (copy feedback). WeekTabView drops the
checkbox; the prev/current/next toolbar, title, week total, contributor band
and status line stay unchanged.

### Plan slices

1. View models + unit tests (tree model, "<None>", expansion lifecycle).
2. WeekTrackingTree + WeekTabView cutover (checkbox removed).
3. UI tests + README updated; full validation (build, test, format, TZ=UTC).
close_reason: Implemented in cfbf0e0: week view is now a collapsible day/element/task tree; all nodes collapse on open and on week change, expansion survives live refreshes; <None> group for entries without a booking element; element/task copy buttons copy names only; day sum and PC activity on the day node; checkbox and dead ActivityText path removed. 180 tests pass.

title: Move PC Activity Buttons to bottom
description: The buttons "Install PC activity monitor" and "Remove PC activity monitor" within the "Week view" should be moved to the buttom so they are located just the top of the status bar on the bottom.
